summary: The main-branch Swarm Control Plane PR ownership job is globally broken after the V2.1 compatibility-facade split. `.github/workflows/swarm-control.yml` materializes `swarmctl.py` and `swarmctl_hardening.py` into an isolated trusted directory but omits required dependency `swarmctl_hardening_base.py`; every hardened `pr-check` therefore terminates with ModuleNotFoundError before ownership validation. This is independent of PR #272 and blocks authoritative ownership checks for current PRs.
evidence: PR #272 Swarm Control Plane run 31464715467 pr-ownership retry job 93695285055 fails at `import swarmctl_hardening_base as _base` with `ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'swarmctl_hardening_base'`.
main `.github/workflows/swarm-control.yml` trusted-validator step copies only `tools/swarm/swarmctl.py` and `tools/swarm/swarmctl_hardening.py` into `$RUNNER_TEMP/trusted-swarm`.
main `tools/swarm/swarmctl_hardening.py` imports `swarmctl_hardening_base` on line 10, and `tools/swarm/swarmctl_hardening_base.py` exists on main but is not materialized by the workflow.
Re-running failed workflow jobs reproduces the same missing-module failure, ruling out claim timing as the cause.
